_comment: Baseline warning counts for the #2391 warning gate. scripts/warning_gate.py fails CI when RuntimeWarning/ResourceWarning rise above baseline + tolerance (see the script for the margin). Only the gated categories below are enforced; DeprecationWarning et al. are reported in the artifact but not gated. Re-baseline intentionally with: python scripts/warning_gate.py --report-dir .warning-report --update-baseline.
